component.name: EchoDesk
component.summary: 纯本地的 AI 桌面助手

description.p: EchoDesk runs a local model on your own machine and keeps conversation history, documents and search results there. It reads Office/TXT/PDF files, runs agent workflows and automation, loads plugins, and speaks MCP — without sending your data to a server.
EchoDesk 在本机运行模型，对话记录、文档与检索结果都留在本机。可读取 Office/TXT/PDF、 运行 Agent 与自动化、加载插件、接入 MCP —— 不把数据发往服务器。
